title: Truss Bridge Span Force Diagram
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive truss bridge span force diagram with a movable toy car load. Load the 3D model 'ToyCar.glb' using GLTFLoader from the Three.js examples CDN.

## Scene Setup
- Background color: #1a1a2e. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 20) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5, 15, 10) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Render on the full viewport with antialiasing. Add OrbitControls.

## Truss Bridge Structure
- Build a Warren-style truss bridge spanning from x=-12 to x=12 (total span 24 units), with the deck at y=0 and top chord at y=4.
- The bridge has 6 equal panels (each 4 units wide). Bottom chord nodes at x = -12, -8, -4, 0, 4, 8, 12 (7 nodes). Top chord nodes at x = -10, -6, -2, 2, 6, 10 (6 nodes, offset by 2 units, at y=4).
- Draw all truss members as CylinderGeometry tubes (radius 0.08) connecting: bottom chord segments, top chord segments, and diagonal/vertical web members forming the Warren pattern (zigzag diagonals between top and bottom chords).
- Color members based on force: blue for compression, red for tension, gray (#888888) for zero-force. Use MeshStandardMaterial.
- Draw the bridge deck as a thin box (24 x 0.15 x 3) at y=-0.1, color #555555.
- Mark support points: pin support (triangle) at x=-12 (left) and roller support (circle) at x=12 (right). Use small mesh indicators.

## Toy Car (Load)
- Load ToyCar.glb and place it on the bridge deck. Scale it so it fits roughly 1.5 units wide. Position it initially at x=0, on top of the deck surface.
- The car represents a point load of 10 kN (store as variable). The car can be moved left/right along the bridge deck using arrow keys (Left/Right) in increments of 0.5 units, clamped to x in [-11, 11].
- Show a downward arrow (yellow, using a ConeGeometry + CylinderGeometry) above the car indicating the applied load.

## Force Analysis (Method of Joints - Simplified)
- Implement a simplified static analysis: the bridge is simply supported (pin at left, roller at right). Given the car position along the span, compute vertical reactions at both supports using equilibrium (R_left = P * (L - d) / L, R_right = P * d / L, where d is distance from left support, L = 24, P = 10).
- For each truss member, compute the axial force using the method of joints or method of sections. Store forces for ALL members. Positive = tension, negative = compression.
- Update member colors in real-time as the car moves: tension members turn red with intensity proportional to |force|/maxForce, compression members turn blue similarly, near-zero members stay gray.
- Display force magnitude labels (as sprite text or HTML overlay) on each member when 'Show Labels' is toggled on.

## HUD / UI Panel
- Create a DOM panel (top-left, semi-transparent dark background, 280px wide) showing:
  - Car position (x value, 2 decimal places)
  - Left reaction force (2 decimal places, in kN)
  - Right reaction force (2 decimal places, in kN)
  - Sum of reactions (should always equal 10.00 kN - conservation check)
  - Maximum tension force and which member
  - Maximum compression force and which member
  - Total member count
- Buttons:
  - 'Reset Position' (id='resetBtn'): moves car back to x=0
  - 'Toggle Labels' (id='toggleLabelsBtn'): show/hide force labels on members
  - 'Toggle Diagram' (id='toggleDiagramBtn'): show/hide a 2D influence line diagram overlay (canvas-based) at the bottom of the screen showing how left reaction varies as load moves across span
  - 'Undo' (id='undoBtn'): undo last car movement (maintain a history stack of positions, max 50)
  - 'Redo' (id='redoBtn'): redo undone movement
  - 'Apply Wind Load' (id='windBtn'): toggles a horizontal wind load of 2 kN applied at each top chord node (affects force calculations), button text changes to 'Remove Wind Load' when active

## Keyboard Controls
- ArrowLeft: move car left by 0.5 units (push to undo stack, clear redo stack)
- ArrowRight: move car right by 0.5 units (push to undo stack, clear redo stack)
- 'r' key: reset car to center
- 'l' key: toggle labels
- 'w' key: toggle wind load
- Ctrl+Z: undo
- Ctrl+Y: redo

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- carPositionX: number (current car x position)
- leftReaction: number (left support reaction in kN)
- rightReaction: number (right support reaction in kN)
- reactionSum: number (sum of both reactions)
- memberCount: number (total truss members)
- memberForces: array of {id: string, force: number} for each member
- maxTensionForce: number (max positive force value)
- maxCompressionForce: number (max negative force value, stored as negative)
- labelsVisible: boolean
- diagramVisible: boolean
- windLoadActive: boolean
- undoStackSize: number
- redoStackSize: number
- topChordNodeCount: number (should be 6)
- bottomChordNodeCount: number (should be 7)
- carLoaded: boolean (true once GLB model is loaded)
- supportReactionConserved: boolean (true if |reactionSum - totalLoad| < 0.001, where totalLoad depends on wind)
- totalAppliedLoad: number (10 without wind, different with wind)
- windForcePerNode: number (0 or 2)
- memberColorStates: array of 'tension'|'compression'|'zero' for each member
physics_constraints: Static equilibrium must hold at all times: sum of vertical reactions must equal total vertical load (10 kN without wind). Moment equilibrium about each support must be satisfied. All member forces must be finite (no NaN/Infinity). Car position must remain within bridge span [-11, 11]. When wind load is applied, horizontal equilibrium must also be maintained. Force magnitudes must change continuously as car moves (no discontinuities). Conservation: reactionSum must equal totalAppliedLoad within epsilon 0.001 at all times.
